description: Human-readable explanations for managed global settings. Keep runtime values in global_settings.json; keep field meaning, UX help text, and operational guidance here.

fit_highlights.description: Controls how many positive fit reasons are shown on each job card.

fields.strong_capability_count: Maximum number of strong capability matches to show in job highlights.
fields.working_capability_count: Maximum number of working-level capability matches to show in job highlights.
fields.basic_capability_count: Maximum number of basic capability matches to show in job highlights.
fields.reviewed_signal_count: Maximum number of approved reviewed signals to surface as fit evidence.
fields.max_highlights: Overall cap for visible positive highlight items on a job card.

search_settings.description: Default search behaviour shared across the app before user/profile-specific overrides are applied.

fields.keywords: Default search keyword string. Usually empty because candidate search terms come from onboarding/profile setup.
fields.locations: Default search locations used when no user/profile location is supplied.
fields.classification_ids: Default job-board classification IDs used for broad pre-filtering.
fields.date_range_days: How many days back SEEK-style searches should look by default.
fields.seek_max_pages: Maximum number of SEEK result pages to crawl by default.
fields.sort_newest_first: When true, workspace/search defaults prefer newer listings first.
fields.linkedin_hours_old: How fresh LinkedIn listings must be, measured in hours.
fields.linkedin_results_per_search: Maximum LinkedIn results collected per keyword/location search pair.
fields.linkedin_fetch_timeout_seconds: Maximum seconds allowed for each LinkedIn jobspy search request before the scraper aborts that target.
fields.linkedin_easy_apply_only: Optional LinkedIn Easy Apply filter. Null means do not force either direction.
fields.playwright_viewport_width: Browser viewport width used by Playwright source connectors.
fields.playwright_viewport_height: Browser viewport height used by Playwright source connectors.
fields.playwright_selector_timeout: How long Playwright waits for required selectors before failing a browser interaction.

limits.search.description: Validation bounds for search defaults. These prevent UI/API values from drifting outside safe ranges.

fields.date_range_days: Allowed min/max for the search date window in days.
fields.seek_max_pages: Allowed min/max for the SEEK page crawl cap.
fields.linkedin_hours_old: Allowed min/max for LinkedIn listing freshness in hours.
fields.linkedin_results_per_search: Allowed min/max for LinkedIn results per search pair.
fields.linkedin_fetch_timeout_seconds: Allowed min/max for the per-target LinkedIn fetch timeout in seconds.

limits.salary.description: Validation bounds for salary and daily-rate inputs.

fields.minimum_salary_yearly: Allowed min/max for permanent annual salary targets.
fields.minimum_daily_rate: Allowed min/max for contract daily-rate targets.

limits.onboarding.description: Validation bounds for onboarding extraction and capability tuning settings.

fields.extraction_lookback_years: Allowed min/max for how far back onboarding may inspect role history.
fields.title_extraction_min_months: Allowed min/max role duration required before a role can count as a title signal.
fields.max_target_patterns: Allowed min/max for primary target title patterns kept from onboarding.
fields.max_secondary_patterns: Allowed min/max for secondary title patterns kept from onboarding.
fields.capability_recent_years: Allowed min/max for what counts as recent capability use.
fields.capability_strong_max_years_since_use: Allowed min/max for how recently a strong capability must have been used.
fields.capability_strong_min_months: Allowed min/max experience duration required for strong capability classification.
fields.capability_working_max_years_since_use: Allowed min/max for how recently a working capability must have been used.
fields.capability_working_min_months: Allowed min/max experience duration required for working capability classification.
fields.capability_working_long_history_max_year: Allowed min/max older-use window for long-history working capabilities.
fields.capability_working_long_history_min_mont: Allowed min/max total duration required for long-history working capabilities.
fields.capability_drop_to_basic_after_years: Allowed min/max age after which an old capability drops to basic.
fields.capability_max_items: Allowed min/max number of capability rules kept after onboarding.
fields.capability_alias_limit: Allowed min/max aliases the LLM generates per capability during CV extraction.
fields.cv_max_pages: Allowed min/max number of CV pages read during onboarding.
fields.signal_cluster_min_alias_hits: Allowed min/max alias-hit threshold for keeping learned signal clusters.
fields.signal_cluster_min_snippet_hits: Allowed min/max snippet-hit threshold for keeping learned signal clusters.
fields.signal_cluster_dense_snippet_alias_hits: Allowed min/max dense-snippet alias threshold for keeping a signal cluster.

limits.history.description: Validation bounds for history and repeated-listing red-flag settings.

fields.job_history_max_entries: Allowed min/max number of saved job-history records kept per user.
fields.job_history_max_age_days: Allowed min/max age for saved job-history records before pruning.
fields.repeated_listing_min_times_seen: Allowed min/max number of sightings before repeated-listing detection can trigger.
fields.repeated_listing_min_span_days: Allowed min/max day span required before repeated-listing detection can trigger.
fields.multi_listing_red_flag_min_listings: Allowed min/max number of related listings required before multi-listing red-flag detection can trigger.
fields.multi_listing_red_flag_min_span_days: Allowed min/max day span required before multi-listing red-flag detection can trigger.

limits.cache.description: Validation bounds for runtime cache retention settings.

fields.llm_cache_max_entries: Allowed min/max number of saved LLM cache entries.
fields.llm_cache_max_age_days: Allowed min/max age for saved LLM cache entries before pruning.
fields.cv_extraction_cache_max_entries: Allowed min/max number of saved CV extraction cache entries.
fields.cv_extraction_cache_max_age_days: Allowed min/max age for saved CV extraction cache entries before pruning.
fields.candidate_application_history_cache_max_: Allowed min/max number of saved candidate application history extraction cache entries.
Allowed min/max age for saved candidate application history extraction cache entries before pruning.
fields.occupation_title_cache_max_entries: Allowed min/max number of saved occupation-title classification cache rows.
fields.occupation_title_cache_max_age_days: Allowed min/max age for occupation-title classification cache rows before pruning.
fields.source_discovery_cache_max_entries: Allowed min/max number of source discovery snapshots retained per user.
fields.source_discovery_cache_max_age_minutes: Allowed min/max freshness window for successful source discovery snapshots.
fields.linkedin_failure_backoff_minutes: Allowed min/max temporary backoff window after a fully timed-out identical LinkedIn search.
fields.search_plan_min_corroboration_samples: Allowed min/max number of matching complete observations a remembered source search plan must accumulate before it is trusted to prune redundant role queries.
fields.linkedin_stale_fallback_max_age_minutes: Allowed min/max age of a known-good LinkedIn snapshot that may still be reused when a live search is unavailable.
fields.linkedin_max_consecutive_target_failures: Allowed min/max consecutive LinkedIn target failures before the run stops submitting further searches.

preference_weights.description: Weights that shape the global job fit score. Higher values make that dimension move rankings more strongly; zero effectively ignores it.

fields.salary: Weight for salary or daily-rate alignment.
fields.location: Weight for location and travel preference alignment.
fields.contract: Weight for work-type preference alignment, including Permanent, Contract, and FTC, plus contract-length preference where relevant.

candidate_profile_tier_weights.description: Weights applied to different profile evidence tiers when judging whether the candidate really has a capability.

fields.primary_candidate_profile_context: Highest-confidence candidate evidence, usually recent/direct CV evidence.
fields.secondary_candidate_profile_context: Medium-confidence candidate evidence, useful but weaker than primary profile context.
fields.supplementary_candidate_profile_context: Lowest-confidence background evidence, used carefully so old or indirect experience does not over-score a role.

history_settings.description: Controls archive freshness, hidden-job review timing, and repeated-listing red flags.

fields.job_history_max_entries: Maximum number of saved job-history records kept per user before the oldest entries are pruned.
fields.job_history_max_age_days: Maximum age for saved job-history records before they are pruned.
fields.archive_stale_after_days: How long archived jobs stay fresh before they are considered stale.
fields.hidden_review_days: How long hidden jobs stay hidden before they become eligible for review again.
fields.repeated_listing_min_times_seen: How many times the same listing must be seen before a repeated-listing red flag can trigger.
fields.repeated_listing_min_span_days: Minimum days between first and last sighting before repeated-listing detection can trigger.
fields.multi_listing_red_flag_min_listings: How many similar listings from the same source/company/title cluster trigger a multi-listing red flag.
fields.multi_listing_red_flag_min_span_days: Minimum day span across similar listings before a multi-listing red flag can trigger.

cache_settings.description: Controls how many shared runtime cache entries are kept and, for occupation-title classifications, how old they may be.

fields.llm_cache_max_entries: Maximum number of saved LLM cache entries kept on disk.
fields.llm_cache_max_age_days: Maximum age for saved LLM cache entries before pruning.
fields.cv_extraction_cache_max_entries: Maximum number of saved CV extraction cache entries kept on disk.
fields.cv_extraction_cache_max_age_days: Maximum age for saved CV extraction cache entries before pruning.
fields.candidate_application_history_cache_max_: Maximum number of saved candidate application history extraction cache entries kept on disk.
Maximum age for saved candidate application history extraction cache entries before pruning.
fields.occupation_title_cache_max_entries: Maximum number of saved occupation-title classification cache rows kept in SQLite.
fields.occupation_title_cache_max_age_days: Maximum age for saved occupation-title classification cache rows before pruning.
fields.source_discovery_cache_max_entries: Maximum number of saved source discovery snapshots kept per user.
fields.source_discovery_cache_max_age_minutes: How many minutes a successful source discovery snapshot can be reused.
fields.linkedin_failure_backoff_minutes: How many minutes a fully timed-out identical LinkedIn search is suppressed before retrying.
fields.search_plan_min_corroboration_samples: How many matching complete observations a remembered source search plan must accumulate before its selected role terms are trusted to prune redundant queries. Below this, every configured term is probed conservatively.
fields.linkedin_stale_fallback_max_age_minutes: How old a known-good LinkedIn discovery snapshot may be and still be served when an identical live search is in backoff or just failed entirely. Posting ages are conservatively aged forward before date-range filtering.
fields.linkedin_max_consecutive_target_failures: How many consecutive LinkedIn target failures (timeouts or errors) are allowed in one run before the circuit breaker stops submitting further searches.

description_trust_settings.description: Controls whether fallback job-description text is trusted enough for fit review and scoring.

fields.min_trusted_description_length: Minimum fallback description length required before the system treats the text as a trusted full description.

source_document_settings.description: Controls source document handling for CV/onboarding material.

fields.cv_chars_per_page: Approximate character budget used per CV page when limiting extraction input.
fields.allowed_suffixes: File suffixes accepted for CV/source uploads. Keep restricted to supported parsers.

default_country_suffix.description: Country suffix removed from repeated display text where appropriate. Example: trimming repeated 'Australia' from location labels.

onboarding_settings.description: Defaults used when building or rebuilding a candidate profile from onboarding/CV material.

fields.extraction_lookback_years: How far back the onboarding extractor looks through role history.
fields.title_extraction_min_months: Minimum role duration before a role title can count as a target-title signal.
fields.max_target_patterns: Maximum primary target title patterns kept from onboarding.
fields.max_secondary_patterns: Maximum secondary/also-consider title patterns kept from onboarding.
fields.capability_recent_years: How many years count as recent capability use.
fields.capability_strong_max_years_since_use: Maximum years since last use for a capability to remain strong.
fields.capability_strong_min_months: Minimum experience duration required for strong capability classification.
fields.capability_working_max_years_since_use: Maximum years since last use for a capability to remain working-level.
fields.capability_working_min_months: Minimum experience duration required for working capability classification.
fields.capability_working_long_history_max_year: Older-use allowance for capabilities with long history.
fields.capability_working_long_history_min_mont: Minimum total duration required for older capabilities to remain working-level.
fields.capability_drop_to_basic_after_years: After this many years without use, a capability is downgraded to basic.
fields.capability_max_items: Maximum capability rules kept in the generated profile.
fields.capability_alias_limit: Maximum Related Skills the LLM generates per capability during automatic CV extraction (does not limit persisted or manually confirmed Related Skills).
fields.cv_max_pages: Maximum number of pages read from an uploaded CV during onboarding.
fields.signal_cluster_min_alias_hits: Minimum alias hits required before a learned signal cluster is kept.
fields.signal_cluster_min_snippet_hits: Minimum separate snippets required before a learned signal cluster is kept.
fields.signal_cluster_dense_snippet_alias_hits: Dense alias-hit threshold that can keep a cluster even when snippet count is lower.
fields.capability_strength_preset: Selected preset used to populate capability-strength thresholds.
fields.capability_strength_presets: Named presets for capability recency and strength classification.

llm_settings.description: Controls model choices, pricing, prompt budgets, and LLM runtime limits.

fields.model_options: Models allowed in the runtime LLM selector.
fields.temperature: Sampling temperature applied when a Job Hunter LLM call is not using active reasoning. Lower values make structured classification and extraction more deterministic; valid range is 0 to 2. Calls with reasoning above none use reasoning effort instead.
fields.pricing_per_1m: Input/output token pricing used for local cost logging.
fields.max_llm_chars: Maximum job text kept for LLM review cache keys and prompt construction.
fields.llm_prompt_settings: Nested prompt budgets, item caps, and prompt templates used by LLM review/extraction calls.

llm_settings.llm_prompt_settings.description: Fine-grained limits for LLM prompts and structured outputs. These protect cost, prevent oversized prompts, and reduce malformed JSON risk.

fields.match_preference_templates: Template text injected into fit-review prompts for salary, location, and preference guidance.
fields.evidence_tiers: Profile evidence sections sent to the LLM, with labels, weights, and character limits.
fields.fit_decision_max_output_tokens: Output-token budget for full fit-review calls, including structured requirement coverage.
fields.rejection_blocker_suggestions_max_output: Output-token budget for suggesting blocker terms after rejection feedback.
fields.capability_naming_max_output_tokens: Output-token budget for naming capability clusters.
fields.profile_extraction_max_output_tokens: Output-token budget for extracting profile signals from onboarding/CV material.
fields.job_description_max_chars: Maximum job-description characters sent to rejection-blocker suggestion calls.
fields.cv_evidence_json_chars: Maximum structured CV evidence characters sent to profile extraction.
fields.cv_fallback_chars: Fallback CV text budget when structured evidence is unavailable or insufficient.
fields.capability_rules_max_items: Maximum capability rules included in LLM fit-review prompts.
fields.capability_rule_aliases_max_items: Maximum Related Skills shown per capability rule in LLM fit-review prompts.
fields.fit_guidance_max_chars: Maximum managed fit-review guidance characters included in prompts.
fields.capability_naming_guidance_max_chars: Maximum managed capability-naming guidance characters included in prompts.
fields.capability_naming_aliases_max_items: Maximum Related Skills included when naming capability clusters.
fields.raw_output_log_max_chars: Maximum raw LLM output characters retained in logs when parsing fails.
fields.requirement_coverage_max_items: Maximum capability or qualification requirement-coverage rows requested or kept per fit review.
fields.learning_candidates_max_items: Maximum learning candidates requested/kept per LLM call.
fields.rejection_blocker_suggestions_max_items: Maximum rejection-blocker suggestions returned to the user.
fields.rejection_blocker_suggestions_max_words: Maximum words allowed per rejection-blocker suggestion.

review_settings.description: Controls review-insight generation and rule/capability suggestion thresholds.

fields.max_examples_per_skill: Maximum examples shown per repeated skill or capability insight.
fields.max_samples_per_rejection: Maximum sample rejected jobs inspected per rejection pattern.
fields.capability_suggestion_min_count: Minimum repeated evidence count before suggesting a capability tuning item.
fields.capability_working_min_count: Minimum repeated evidence count before suggesting a capability should be treated as working-level.
fields.title_not_target_min_count: Minimum count before suggesting a title pattern is probably not a target.
fields.rule_suggestion_min_count: Minimum repeated evidence count before suggesting a rule/blocker.

playwright_settings.description: Browser runtime settings used by source connectors.

fields.playwright_viewport_width: Browser viewport width used during scraping.
fields.playwright_viewport_height: Browser viewport height used during scraping.
fields.playwright_selector_timeout: Selector wait timeout in milliseconds before a browser interaction fails.
fields.playwright_browser_mode: Browser lifecycle mode. Ephemeral means the browser session is temporary; persistent keeps the same browser session alive and is required for Assisted SEEK verification.
fields.seek_parallel_detail_workers: Number of parallel Playwright pages used for SEEK detail-page fetches. Higher values speed up processing when many cards need description fetch + LLM review.

candidate_application_history.description: Settings for importing or reading candidate application/rejection history.

fields.enabled: Whether candidate application history is enabled.
fields.source_type: Where application history is read from.
fields.spreadsheet_id: Spreadsheet identifier used when the configured source is a spreadsheet.
fields.required_headers: Headers required in the application history source.
fields.content_max_chars: Maximum message/content characters read from each application history record.
